question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a brown ball, Bob has a blue ball, and Claire has a purple ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Bob swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Finally, Claire and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) brown ball
(B) blue ball
(C) purple ball
solution:
Ball colors in holder order: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: brown | blue | purple
1. Alice–Bob: blue | brown | purple
2. Bob–Claire: blue | purple | brown
3. Claire–Alice: brown | purple | blue
Bob has the purple ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
